title: Asking AftLog a question
description: Get plain-language answers grounded in your boat.

steps.text: Type your question in plain language.
AftLog uses your boat data to answer.
Ask a follow-up, or say 'continue' if an answer is cut off.

tips: Offline, the app uses on-device guidance so you're never stuck.
examples: Why is my tell-tale weak? with your boat context.
What should I check before spring prep?
